topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can scarce believe what I’ve heard! A man, they say, took ink to flesh and marked himself with another’s toil. The artist, they speak of, crafted his visions on paper, fragile things, meant to wander from hand to hand, not to be etched into the hide of a man like some lowly brand. How dare he? To think, the nerve, to take what’s not his and carve it into his own skin. It’s one thing to share the bounty of the earth, but to take art, a piece of someone’s very soul, and make it his own... It’s an outrage. What will be next? My own wheat branded with another’s mark?
